[P2] Complete the compatibility design before raising the minimum

This excludes previously supported VS Code versions 1.90–1.139 to resolve a development-types mismatch. CONTRIBUTING rule 3 requires an options analysis for this public compatibility change. The description explains the cause and selected fix, but does not evaluate retaining compatibility with an appropriate types version; being in alpha does not establish why the newer minimum is necessary. Please return to the design phase under rules 8 and 9, compare those compatibility options, and obtain agreement on the tradeoff before proceeding.
